Error.description: 400 invalid request; 401 missing/incorrect configured API key or invalid/expired session; 403 forbidden or unverified LAN identity when no API key is configured; 404 absent resource; 405 unsupported method; 409 CA changed; 413 body over 1 KiB; 415 wrong media type; 500 persistence failure; 503 starting/reloading. Route/method errors and missing certificates may be plain text.

DeviceStatus.description: The requesting device's MAC-attributed upstream paths. IPv4 and IPv6 share the MAC identity. Counters survive reload and reset on daemon restart. Kernel passthrough, local HTTP/DNS responses and daemon-originated work are excluded; splice deltas are included.

states.description: For checked groups, 10 oldest-first buckets spanning the last hour (6 minutes each); the worst state in each bucket. Unchecked groups have no history.

networks.description: Network order: tcp4, tcp6, udp4, udp6.

selected_node_ids.description: Network order: tcp4, tcp6, udp4, udp6.

LatencyStats.description: Successful probe durations only. Failures and selection offsets are excluded; average_10 uses the last ten successful samples.

tracking.description: Group-local scheduling role. Standby paths may still be monitored by another group; active operations are reported by recovery.

recovery_elapsed.description: Successfully verified observation time, in nanoseconds.

failure_recovery.description: Required recovery observation duration, in nanoseconds.

score.description: Selection score in nanoseconds; may be negative.

BufferMemoryStatus.description: Process-wide MITM body buffer budget. Byte counters measure reserved buffer storage; denied counts rejected reservations.

limit.description: Configured byte limit. Lowering it does not revoke existing reservations, so used may temporarily exceed limit.

peak.description: Peak reserved bytes over the process lifetime.

denied.description: Rejected reservation count over the process lifetime (unsigned 64-bit integer).

buffer_memory.description: Optional process-wide budget snapshot, repeated on each instance. Do not sum it across instances.

details.description: Plugin-defined JSON report. Surge uses the SurgeStatus schema, including explicit script notification text. Reports exclude configuration credentials.

result.description: Publication result, including the number of groups using previous contents after a failed refresh.

module.description: Required when the script name is not unique within the instance.

ScriptTaskStatus.description: A Surge cron or generic task. Times describe the latest scheduled or manual attempt, including execution-slot waits. Only cron has a schedule and timezone; generic is ready when idle and active. Runtime success does not imply application-level success; errors are credential-free categories. Counters and history reset on reload.

last_error.description: Stable failure category, such as timeout, canceled, error or http_client_unavailable. No raw script exceptions or response bodies.

skipped.description: Schedule ticks skipped because this task was still waiting or running.

NodeEgress.description: Local connection to the first proxy, independent of destination network support.

dormant.description: The physical transport has been released and is not being recreated. Omitted when false; independent of group-local selection tracking.

support.description: Network order: tcp4, tcp6, udp4, udp6.

download_bytes.description: Unsigned 64-bit count; JavaScript clients must account for integer precision above 2^53-1.

upload_bytes.description: Unsigned 64-bit count; JavaScript clients must account for integer precision above 2^53-1.

checked_at.description: Completion time of the last test; absent before the first completed test. Untracked results are historical.

checking.description: A test is queued/running, or the monitored node awaits its initial check. Untested dormant nodes are not checking.

name.description: Saved logical path name, including its entrance choice.

status.description: Missing or ambiguous preferences remain saved while the startup choice is used temporarily.

track_all.description: Read-only group track_all configuration. False by default: only the selected node is monitored. Configure the file and reload to change it.

default_node_id.description: Present only for an explicitly indexed selector(n). Plain selector has no configured default and cannot be reset.

overridden.description: A saved preference exists, including when it is temporarily missing or ambiguous.

auth_mode.description: The request's administrative access mode: configured API key/session, verified direct LAN identity with no configured key, or filesystem-authorized Unix socket. LAN access is revalidated for every request and creates no browser session.

outbound.description: Name of an instantiated, checked outbound. Applies to selector and automatic policies, and checked direct-node targets.

node_id.description: Path ID within that outbound. Empty or omitted probes every path once.

node_ids.description: Accepted targets, including requests coalesced with queued/running checks. Acceptance is not a health result.

direct_fallback_connections.description: Process-lifetime count of established no-connectivity fallbacks to direct; preserved across reloads. Not a per-path or per-node counter.

networks.description: Network order: tcp4, tcp6, udp4, udp6.

notifications.description: All retained explicit script notifications for this instance, newest first. Each script (module, script name and script type) retains up to 50 messages within a shared conservative 1 MiB JSON budget. The longest histories lose their oldest entries first; ties remove the oldest entry, so fewer than 50 messages may remain per script. CLI text defaults to 3 per script; --verbose and JSON show all retained messages. In-memory history resets on reload and is independent of the log level and script success.

SurgeNotification.description: Text supplied by $notification.post. Module, script, title and subtitle are capped at 1024 UTF-8 bytes each; body at 4096 bytes. Original line breaks are retained. Extra notification options are ignored.

instance.description: Added by clients when combining plugin reports.

id.description: Per-instance arrival sequence, reset on reload.

truncated.description: True when any text field was shortened to its byte limit.

candidates.description: IP states with a nonzero domain bitmap before capacity selection. candidates - used is the number excluded by kernel capacity.

used.description: Resident IP count for domain-kernel; retained domain-IP pair count for domain-registry.

domains.description: Distinct retained domain names, including evidence not projected into the kernel.

ips.description: Distinct retained IPs across all domains; equals ipv4 + ipv6. A shared IP counts once.

ipv4.description: Distinct retained IPv4 addresses, not domain-IP pairs.

ipv6.description: Distinct retained IPv6 addresses, not domain-IP pairs.

gc.description: Pairs removed by time-based GC, cumulative across reload and reset on cold start. Unsigned 64-bit count; JavaScript clients must account for integer precision above 2^53-1.

download_bytes_per_second.description: Oldest first; completed 5-second averages in bytes/second. Both directions have equal length, 0–12 samples.

items.description: Unsigned 64-bit count; JavaScript clients must account for integer precision above 2^53-1.

upload_bytes_per_second.description: Oldest first; completed 5-second averages in bytes/second. Both directions have equal length, 0–12 samples.

items.description: Unsigned 64-bit count; JavaScript clients must account for integer precision above 2^53-1.

ResourceRef.description: Unsigned resource identifiers; generations are comparable only within the same owner and resource.

retry_at.description: Actual timer deadline, present only during backoff. Omitted when no retry timer is owned.

FailureSnapshot.description: Classified failure metadata; message is display text and must not be used as a metric label.

bearerAuth.description: The configured global.api_key, sent as a Bearer credential.

sessionCookie.name: dae_session
sessionCookie.description: Signed seven-day browser session issued by PUT /api/session. HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict; scoped to /api and the listener host/port. Changing global.api_key invalidates it. An explicit Authorization header takes precedence.

info.description: Status schema 12. Direct fallback connections are a single process-lifetime counter outside path statistics. Node latency includes successful probes only; selection reports degradation and scoring independently. Domain tables report distinct retained domain/IP counts, kernel candidates and time-based GC; limit zero denotes unbounded userspace retention. TCP uses the router literal IP and configured api_port. The mode-0600 Unix socket /var/run/dae.sock provides local administration. Device self-service requires a direct TCP LAN connection. Mutations require X-Dae-API: 1. No query parameters; request bodies are limited to 1 KiB. Same-origin browser requests only; forwarding headers are not trusted. Successful operations return JSON, except certificate downloads and session changes (204). GET routes also accept HEAD. Counters are process-lifetime; poll with backoff on 503 during reload.

post.summary: Trigger an existing cron or generic task
post.description: Requires administration. Returns 202 with an acceptance snapshot and per-task run number; execution belongs to the daemon and continues after the HTTP response. Inspect the plugin status for completion. Concurrent triggers for a waiting/running task return 409. Does not change its timer schedule. Unknown task/instance: 404; ambiguous name: 400; inactive worker: 503. No inline scripts, source URLs, argument overrides or automatic retries.

Requires administration. Uses the outbound's configured DNS probe, existing concurrency bounds and timeouts. No arbitrary URL, network, or timeout overrides are accepted. node_id selects one path; omission or an empty value selects all paths. Returns 202 immediately with accepted IDs; repeated requests for queued/running work coalesce. Selector results are available through GET /api/selectors (checking/tested/checked_at/healthy/latency_ms); other outbounds publish their runtime health and latency through GET /api/status. This is not a persistent probe job and does not change selection or monitoring configuration. Unknown outbound: 404; invalid node/body: 400; unchecked builtin: 409.

get.summary: Read the latest resource refresh and next automatic check
get.description: Requires administration. Reports the latest API or automatic refresh. History is reset on daemon restart. Empty request body.

post.description: Requires administration and an empty request body. Uses the accepted configuration and attempts all downloads regardless of update intervals; does not read configuration edits from disk. Returns 202 immediately; check GET /api/resources for completion. Concurrent queued/running refreshes return 409. Refreshes and reloads publish serially. Invalid candidates leave the current runtime active; available validated snapshots can be used on download failure.

put.description: With a configured global.api_key, requires Authorization: Bearer <api_key>, including on Unix, and issues a signed seven-day session cookie without the API key. Missing/incorrect credentials return 401. Without a configured key, requires a verified direct LAN connection or filesystem-authorized Unix access, returns 204 and clears stale cookies without issuing a session; failed LAN identification returns 403. Empty request body.

delete.description: Empty request body. Clears the caller's cookie even if its session is expired. Does not require authentication.
